Devon Westhill, the USDA's Assistant Secretary for Civil Rights, on the USDA eliminating disparate impact liability under Title VI:

"Without @GailHeriot and Roger Clegg, who laid the intellectual foundation over decades, and a president now willing to act on it, this return to our founding promise of equality under the law would not have come."
